result.notes:
All data was fetched on 2026-10-10 (Saturday) with WebFetch. The latest trading day was 2026-10-08, because 10-09 was the 國慶日 make-up holiday.

Key findings:
(1) All openapi.twse.com.tw datasets return a JSON array at the root with every value as a string. Dates are in ROC format: YYYMMDD (e.g. "1151008") or YYYMM ("11508"). Convert with year + 1911. Exceptions: t187ap03_L 成立日期/上市日期 are Gregorian YYYYMMDD, and the www.twse.com.tw legacy endpoints take and return Gregorian "date":"20261008".
(2) ETFs (00xx, 00xxxA, 006208 etc.) ARE in STOCK_DAY_ALL, appear first, and some have empty-string prices or volume when there are no trades.
(3) Data date: use STOCK_DAY_ALL / BWIBBU_ALL "Date" or MI_INDEX "日期". openapi MI_MARGN has no date field. Its values matched the dated legacy endpoint for 20261008.
(4) The three institutional investors data (T86) is not on openapi (/v1/fund/T86 returns 404). The /rwd/zh/... URLs for T86 and MI_MARGN returned a '網站維護中' maintenance page at fetch time (weekend). The legacy URLs worked: https://www.twse.com.tw/fund/T86?response=json&date=YYYYMMDD&selectType=ALLBUT0999 and https://www.twse.com.tw/exchangeReport/MI_MARGN?response=json&date=YYYYMMDD&selectType=ALL. Implement rwd plus a legacy fallback, and check stat=="OK".
(5) The EPS datasets (t187ap14_L, t187ap06_L_*) are year-to-date cumulative (inferred from 1101 revenue vs monthly revenue). The latest available is 年度 115 季別 2. The EPS key spelling differs: t187ap14_L uses 基本每股盈餘(元) with ASCII parentheses, while t187ap06_L_* uses 基本每股盈餘（元） with full-width parentheses.
(6) Monthly revenue t187ap05_L lags: it still showed 11508 on 10-10.
(7) Industry codes in t187ap03_L are 2-digit codes with no official mapping found. Use the Chinese 產業別 from t187ap05_L or t187ap14_L, or the community mapping given in tw_industry_code_map (verified=false).

Limits: WebFetch shows only about the first 80K chars of each response (and about 51K of swagger.json), so I could not enumerate the full swagger endpoint list. Rows beyond the cutoff (e.g. 2330 in STOCK_DAY_ALL, MI_MARGN and T86) were not visible. Sample records were rebuilt from field values the fetch tool reported (it refuses long verbatim quotes), except the MI_INDEX and holiday records, which it quoted directly. Revenue/income units of thousand NTD are inferred, not stated. MI_MARGN units are 交易單位 (=張 for ordinary stocks) per the legacy endpoint's row label. T86 unit is shares per hints "單位：股". Update times of each openapi dataset during the day were not verified. Run the Action in the evening Taiwan time and check that the date fields equal the expected trading day before overwriting JSON.
